pages.title: Finite to Unbounded
pages.text: Stage five is the final finite Kongqiao. Fill aura progress and prepare ascension materials. Ascension converts carried and stored True Power once at 16:1; newly acquired True Power is never auto-converted afterward.

After stage six, tribulations start only inside your own Xianqiao realm. Permanent Cultivation effects pause during the fight. Death or failure clears the summon and current Immortal Power, then revives you in place with items retained; your stage never falls.
Default enemies are Zombie, Wither Skeleton, Vindicator and Warden. They glow permanently, have Strength III and ten times base health. Packs may configure targets and the maximum normal stage.
